Lead source: self-serve signup (marketing site) 2026-02-24.

Initial POV and need: small-ish DTC retailer (home + kitchen goods). Looking to add product Q&A on PDPs + catalog enrichment (auto-tags, short descriptions) to improve conversion and reduce CS tickets. Very bursty traffic: weekly promo windows and weekend peaks (10x baseline). CTO comment: "Need answers to be fast — customer-facing UI should feel instant on product pages."

Technical requirements / constraints:
- Prefer hosted API for quick rollout; want to remain in public cloud. No on-prem this round.
- Latency target: p50 <150ms, p95 <400ms for Q&A across small context (~512 tokens).
- Throughput: baseline 5-10 rps, bursts to 50-70 rps during promos for short periods.
- Catalog size: ~25k SKUs with frequent daily SKU additions (~50/day). Embedding index needs fast incremental updates (goal: <5 min).
- Cost sensitivity: SMB budget; interested in batching/caching suggestions. Must see token-cost estimate for burst scenario.

Model preferences / approach discussed:
- Start with a small instruction-tuned open model for Q&A (cost-sensitive).
- Use embeddings for similarity / cross-sell + tag auto-generation.
- Fallback policy: simple heuristic QA when latency or capacity constraints hit.
